title: Monitor Accuracy Isn't the Answer: A Decision-Value Framework for Evaluating AI Agent Restart Monitors
author: Siddharth Jain, Venkat N. Vedam
description: Classification accuracy and true-positive and false-positive rates alone do not determine whether restarting an AI agent improves success. summary: Classification accuracy and true-positive and false-positive rates alone do not determine whether restarting an AI agent improves success. We introduce two techniques for evaluating monitors and progress signals in decision terms.
takeaways: These results motivate evaluating agent monitors through recovery opportunity, decision value, and statistical support, rather than classification performance alone.

Second, a finite-sample, model-free decision audit uses simultaneous binomial intervals over existing agent traces, without additional model calls, to certify a preference for "restart" or "continue" under stated sampling assumptions, or return "abstain" when evidence is insufficient.
We introduce two techniques for evaluating monitors and progress signals in decision terms.
